steps.text: The official forms are generated from the CRM's data. The generate icon appears on every document whose template the regulator provides: click it on the document to prepare — here, Annex 6.
steps.title: The documents to generate

steps.text: Nothing is filed without your review. The fields are pre-filled from the CRM and stay editable: what you approve here is exactly what gets frozen into the document.
steps.title: Check the data

steps.text: A correction made here applies to this document only. If a value is wrong everywhere, fix it in the CRM instead and reload the form.
steps.title: Correct a value

steps.text: The generation runs in the background. You can carry on working: the document shows "Generating" and updates on its own.
steps.title: Start the generation

title: Generate a document from the CRM
